definitions: New48, old96, preflight and Go are separate populations; no pooled totals.
Generation, independent acceptance and total elapsed time are separate. All failed trials remain in time/call numerators.
P50/P95 use nearest rank; nested workflow/provider time is not added to wall time.
Paired success differences compare the same12 fixed fixtures; conditional both-accepted timing is a separate subset.
Case bootstrap is descriptive for this small fixed sample, not general model superiority or population confidence.
Single baselines have no compulsory independent review; provider success is not external acceptance.
Unknown usage stays null. Claude client API estimates and conditional Codex API equivalents are not subscription cash.
Instrumented receipt envelopes and child-only context controls differ from the historical protocol; historical comparisons are descriptive.
All four arms use actual official CLIs and the original SDK under private output-envelope/receipt observation and source/auth/hash checks.

Observed wall time includes receipt I/O, proof verification and JSON envelope overhead; this is not uninstrumented product-only latency. Envelope traffic may reach the unchanged10MiB output guard sooner.
Requested model/effort, permissions, public task prompts, generation240s/apply and separate acceptance30s are retained; session context exclusions and subscription route pins are added.
Old96 used different collectors, CLI patch versions and source; no trend improvement or pooled population is claimed.
Projection validates selected closure/bindings but does not replay acceptance or independently recompute raw trials; root strict audit remains required.

separate_go_task.build_binding_scope: Go build binds the source map/count, not a separately reported commit. HEAD/tree are from the exact matching root source table.
separate_go_task.build_observation_scope: Offline build under V1 unauthorized preparation; actual task/receipt observation uses the separately pinned authorized collector. Build is not model authentication evidence.

composition_scope: Only already-audited public projections are composed. Root actual raw/phase/host closure audit remains required.

optional_independent_go_failure_detail.summary: Model candidate duplicate-title allocation has quadratic behavior; reviewer P2; no-auto-fix.

failed_preflight.interpretation: All three failed runs and time/usage remain recorded. The omitted tool-host dependency compromises this calibration as a clean model-quality rate. Provider SDK success is not accepted delivery.

limitations: CLI requested labels are configured model choices; reported labels are only receipt evidence, not separately verified service routing.
Claude client API estimates are local estimates, not subscription charges. Codex cash remains unknown.
Codex cached input and reasoning are included in input/output totals and are not added again.
Non-model status/RPC and helper doctor do not establish actual model-tool or task success.
Original failures and six lifetime reservations are preserved; later Go/formal outcomes remain separate.
